records.query: What is the difference between emergency shutdown and post-shutdown procedures as per the AFTF technical manual?

records.query: What caution is taken into consideration while using high-pressure wash equipment, and explain the function of the portable, 45-gallon, foam-generating cleaning unit?
records.reference: When using high-pressure wash equipment, caution must be taken to ensure it is never used on aircraft landing gear and components, wheels, and brakes, as it can force lubricants out of bearings and attachment points, causing corrosion and wear problems. The function of the portable, 45-gallon, foam-generating cleaning unit is to dispense foam. This cleaning unit is a simplified, portable, pressure-operated, foam-dispensing system that uses the available air supply as its power source to force cleaning solution into the hose and create foam.
records.answer: CAUTION (P3208): Do not use high pressure spray nozzles to apply cleaning compounds; cleaning compounds shall only be applied using a low pressure soap nozzle, since high pressure can cause compounds to become entrapped in enclosed areas and cause corrosion. High pressure wash equipment shall never be used on aircraft landing gear and components, wheels, and brakes, as it can force lubricants out of bearings and attach points and cause corrosion and wear. Portable 45-gallon foam-generating cleaning unit (P3211): it is a simplified, portable, pressure-operated foam-dispensing system that uses the available air supply as its power source without pumps. Air is metered directly into the pressurized solution chamber, which forces cleaning solution into the hose to create foam. The foam is applied to the surface, allowed to dwell for a minimum of 1 minute (not long enough to dry), then scrubbed and rinsed.
